name: Ballard Marine Fabricators
old_description: With over 40 years of experience between the three of us, there isn't very much that we can't do. Our passion is welding and fabricating, and providing excellent products and work that we can stand behind one hundred percent. Contact us today and we can get started on your project!
about:
Ballard Marine Fabricators operates from Seattle, Washington, where it was founded in 1986. The shop is 100% welder-owned by three partners—Matt DeVore, Chris Hanson, and Jim Clack—who together bring over 40 years of combined experience in steel vessel repair, aluminum boat building, boiler making, and exhaust systems. The trio launched the business after the fabrication shop they worked for closed without notice, prompting them to start their own operation the very next day.

The company functions as a custom fabrication job shop, producing marine exhaust systems, fuel tanks, handrails, hull repairs, radar and solar arches, offshore brackets, and residential metalwork such as stairs, cable railings, and countertops. Core processes include welding, forming, and fitting of steel and aluminum, with the team handling everything from one-off prototypes to small production runs out of their Ballard Way facility.

Customers span the marine sector—including private boat owners, commercial vessel operators, and offshore platforms—as well as residential clients seeking custom metal fabrication for homes. Concrete projects include code-compliant hull repairs that return vessels to service, exhaust systems built to outlast competitors, and elegant radar arches that integrate power mounting for electronics.

The founders emphasize merging their passion for welding and creative problem-solving to deliver solutions that not only look great but stand the test of time. The shop’s “BMF way” centers on owning every weld and fabrication, ensuring each piece meets the longevity expectations of harsh marine environments.
